user.title: Totalplay STB discovery and connection
user.description: Enter a decoder IP to verify it directly, or leave the IP blank to discover decoders on the local network. If your STB is on another subnet, enter that subnet (for example 192.168.100.0/24). Manual IPs use the same read-only identification as discovery. Only enable the unverified-IP option if your decoder's information endpoint cannot be reached but you already know its control port works.

data.allow_unverified: Allow manual IP if STB identification fails

discovered.title: Select your Totalplay decoder
discovered.description: Select a decoder identified through Totalplay's local STB information endpoints.

display.title: Connected television
display.description: Select the TV or media player that displays this decoder's HDMI output. Leave blank if it is not available in Home Assistant.

source.title: Totalplay input on TV
source.description: Select the HDMI/input that the Totalplay decoder is connected to. It will be selected only if the TV reports a different current source.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach this IP address and port
error.cannot_identify: No Totalplay STB identity was returned at that IP and port. Check the address/port, or explicitly allow an unverified manual IP.
error.no_devices_found: No Totalplay decoders were identified. If your STB is on another subnet, enter its IP or a custom private discovery subnet.
error.invalid_network: Enter a private IPv4 CIDR subnet of /24 or smaller

init.title: Decoder model and connected television
init.description: Change the STB model and linked hardware without deleting the integration. The existing IP, entity IDs and other options are retained.

source.title: Totalplay input on TV
source.description: Select the HDMI/input for the Totalplay decoder. The integration checks the current source before changing it.
